app_protocol.description: Only flows of this application protocol group.

attribute.description: Annotate each host with owner/category/party (offline tracker attribution).

budget.description: Approximate token budget; low-volume rows drop first.

first_party.description: Domains to treat as first-party when attributing hosts (implies attribute), or "auto" to infer the app's own non-tracker backend domains from the capture.

focus.description: Findings focus: all, privacy (pii) or security.

protocol.description: Only flows carrying this protocol (e.g. tls, http2, mtproto).

session_id.description: Id of a capture session started with start_capture.

show_values.description: Show raw captured values instead of redacting them.

tap.description: Path to a .tap capture file (inside the sandbox root).
